assertion_analysis.would_fail_if: the new identity remained the Git reckon-only tree instead of the paired reckon+skills tree
a legacy package-only identity no longer extracted the package
a legacy package-only image unexpectedly carried skills
an armed legacy image did not keep its old identity
the image resolver refused, or the child process failed to import the image
the child imported checkout_trust outside the materialised image
the fleet-script resolver returned a path outside the materialised image
a commit touching only skills/ left the code identity unchanged
a commit outside reckon/ and skills/ moved the code identity
a package-only image resolved the fleet script successfully
the package-only refusal was raised for a cause other than the missing script

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares a value against the same variable the test supplied to the code under test: the git tree ids come from `git rev-parse HEAD:reckon`, the module and script paths come from a child process imported with PYTHONPATH set to the materialised image, and the refusal text comes from the raised CrewError, all independent of the function under test.

item_verdicts.goal: prompt.txt:30 asks a reloaded process to find the fleet script at its own version; reckon/checkout_trust.py:238-263 builds the paired reckon+skills tree and :427-433 archives it, so the resolver at reckon/crew/routing.py:2049 finds image/skills beside the package.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md reads complete with three commits, a clear checkpoint, focused/suite/mutation/lint logs, and states 7628878d7 introduced the package-only archive with the 21:22Z refusal as the first recorded failure rather than a same-minute cause.
item_verdicts.write_paths: prompt.txt:69-75 grants reckon/checkout_trust.py, reckon/crew/follower_registration.py, the named test, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; git diff 1e44e252..9e4a65c19 changes only the first four.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_reloaded_process_finds_its_fleet_script.py:111 reddens if a commit touching only skills/ leaves the code identity fixed, :113 reddens if an unrelated commit moves it, and negative-control.log shows the positive test failing when the package-only extraction is reinstated.

justifications.fit: reckon/checkout_trust.py:238-266 follows the surrounding subprocess(check=False) idiom of :214-232 and the docstrings name the mechanism, but the test file carries an environment-selected mutation switch at tests/test_a_reloaded_process_finds_its_fleet_script.py:79-86.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/checkout_trust.py:256-263 mktrees the HEAD reckon and skills trees and :427-433 archives them under an empty prefix, and tests/test_a_reloaded_process_finds_its_fleet_script.py:101-106 confirms the resolver returns a script inside the materialised image.

justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 1e44e252..9e4a65c19 changes only the four granted paths named at prompt.txt:69-75, and the fragment writes no evidence prose or figure beyond the node's own landing record.
